_schema.name: model name (CapWords, used as the deepctr.models symbol)
_schema.one_liner: one-sentence description of the key idea

candidates.name: OneTrans
candidates.paper_title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender Systems
candidates.one_liner: Feeds feature-field tokens and behavior-sequence tokens into one Transformer with a structured mask so feature interaction and sequence modeling happen jointly.

candidates.name: FinalMLP
candidates.paper_title: FinalMLP: An Enhanced Two-Stream MLP Model for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Two parallel MLP streams with per-stream feature gating, fused by a multi-head bilinear interaction aggregation head; a simple MLP-only model that rivals complex interaction nets.

candidates.name: MaskNet
candidates.paper_title: MaskNet: Introducing Feature-Wise Multiplication to CTR Ranking Models by Instance-Guided Mask
candidates.one_liner: Applies instance-guided multiplicative masks on feature embeddings / hidden layers (serial or parallel MaskBlocks) to inject feature-wise multiplicative interactions into an MLP.

candidates.name: GDCN
candidates.paper_title: Towards Deeper, Lighter and Interpretable Cross Network for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Gated Deep & Cross Network: adds an information gate to each cross layer of DCN-V2 to filter noisy high-order interactions.

candidates.name: EulerNet
candidates.paper_title: EulerNet: Adaptive Feature Interaction Learning via Euler's Formula for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Learns arbitrary-order feature interactions in a complex vector space via Euler's formula, modeling exponents of interactions as learnable parameters.

candidates.name: FinalNet
candidates.paper_title: FINAL: Factorized Interaction Layer for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Two-stream model built on a Factorized Interaction Layer (FINAL block) that generalizes linear + quadratic feature interactions; a strong MLP-style backbone.

candidates.name: WuKong
candidates.paper_title: Wukong: Towards a Scaling Law for Large-Scale Recommendation
candidates.one_liner: Stacks factorization-machine blocks (LCB/FMB) with MLPs into a dense architecture whose quality scales predictably with model size (a recommendation scaling law).

candidates.name: FCN
candidates.paper_title: FCN: Fusing Exponential and Linear Cross Network for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Combines a Linear Cross Network with an Exponential Cross Network so the model captures both bounded- and unbounded-order feature interactions (successor to GDCN).

candidates.name: QNN
candidates.paper_title: Revisiting Feature Interactions from the Perspective of Quadratic Neural Networks for CTR Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Uses quadratic neurons (Hadamard-product interactions) as the core building block to model explicit second-order feature interactions efficiently.

candidates.name: APG
candidates.paper_title: APG: Adaptive Parameter Generation Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
candidates.one_liner: Generates DNN weights on the fly from instance-specific conditions (adaptive/dynamic weights) instead of using a single shared MLP; a wrapper applicable to many backbones.

candidates.name: TransAct
candidates.paper_title: TransAct: Transformer-based Realtime User Action Model for Recommendation at Pinterest
candidates.one_liner: Transformer over recent real-time user actions fused with batch (long-term) features; an industrial behavior-sequence model in the DIN/BST family.

candidates.name: TWIN
candidates.paper_title: TWIN: Two-stage Interest Network for Lifelong User Behavior Modeling in CTR Prediction at Kuaishou
candidates.one_liner: Two-stage target-attention (GSU+ESU) over lifelong behavior sequences with consistent relevance metrics across stages; for very long user histories.
